title: Battlefield Extra (Napoleonic)
invite: Darling! We're shooting another one of those Napoleonic war dramas. The one with the green jacket. Number 27, I think.
We need a hero for ONE take. You'd be fighting the French Imperial Guard. They're extras. They've been in costume since 5am and they are furious.
We'll send two of ours to back you up: a method actor who hasn't broken character since 2019, and a stunt double who has never done a stunt.
Pays 💵 {cash}. Lunch is a sandwich. One take only, darling. I won't ask twice.

win: Thrilled to share I've wrapped my first feature film! 🎬 I played 'Soldier Who Wins (uncredited)'. The French Imperial Guard did not read the script. Neither did I. #Acting #Grateful #OneTake
Big news: I'm in a period drama! 🎬 Three extras charged me in full uniform. The director shouted 'cut'. Nobody cut. We won anyway. #FilmIndustry #Resilience
loss: Today I learned that background extras in Napoleonic uniforms do not hold back. 🎬 My performance has been described as 'a convincing corpse'. Grateful for the opportunity. #Acting #FailForward
Some personal news: I died on screen today. Several times. The Imperial Guard won this one, but the sandwich was excellent. #FilmIndustry #Resilience

win: That's a WRAP, darling! 💵 {cash}. The director cried. Monty is still in character and has asked for a horse.
loss: Well, it's a wrap. The Imperial Guard took the field and the catering table. 💵 {cash} for your trouble, darling.

from.name: Fenwick & Daughters Catering
from.sub: Events · Silver service · No questions asked

title: Silver Service Waiter (one night only)
invite: Good evening. We're two waiters short for the Fotheringay charity gala tonight. Black tie. Silver service.
One small thing: the guests have been told the waiters are 'part of the entertainment'. They have been drinking since the soup.
You'll be serving with Gaston, our head waiter (thirty years, never dropped a canapé, never forgiven anyone), and Rory, who started this morning.
💵 {cash}, plus whatever's left of the buffet. This is a one-time engagement.

win: Worked a black-tie gala last night as a silver service waiter. 🍾 Learned a lot about hospitality, conflict resolution and how far a vol-au-vent can travel. Sir Giles, you know what you did. #Hospitality #Grateful
Proud to say I served at the Fotheringay charity gala. 🍾 Raised: 💵 thousands for charity. Lowered: three aristocrats, gently, onto the dessert trolley. #Teamwork #SilverService
loss: Last night I worked a charity gala and was 'part of the entertainment'. 🍾 Lord Crump has a wicked left hook and no regrets. Tipped: zero. Learned: everything. #Hospitality #Resilience
Some nights you serve the canapés, and some nights the canapés are served to you, at speed. 🍾 Thank you Gaston for dragging me out by my waistcoat. #FailForward #Hospitality

win: Splendid. 💵 {cash}. Gaston says you may call him Gaston. That has never happened before.
loss: The guests rated the entertainment five stars. 💵 {cash}. Please return the waistcoat.

title: Store Mascot (grand reopening)
invite: Hiya! Our supermarket's grand reopening needs a mascot. You'd be Shelfie, the fun-sized shopping trolley. The suit is a bit warm.
Heads up: three rival mascots from the shop across the road have heard about it. They're coming. They don't have a permit.
Solo job, the suit only fits one. 💵 {cash} and a voucher. Today only!

win: Spent today as Shelfie, the fun-sized shopping trolley, at a grand reopening. 🎈 Three rival mascots tried to crash it. A carrot is now in aisle 4 and will be for some time. #Retail #BrandAmbassador #Grateful
Brand ambassador work can be tough. 🎈 Today I defended a supermarket reopening against a badger, a carrot and a coupon. Undefeated in foam. #Marketing #Resilience
loss: Today a giant carrot beat me up in front of 200 shoppers and a balloon arch. 🎈 I was dressed as a trolley. There is no lesson here. #Retail #FailForward
Grand reopening update: the rival mascots won. 🎈 Barry the Bargain Badger has taken my head (the foam one) as a trophy. #BrandAmbassador #Vulnerability

win: Ribbon cut, rivals routed! 💵 {cash}, and the voucher is valid on any item under 💵 1.
loss: The carrot is our mascot now, apparently. 💵 {cash}. Please return the trolley head if you find it.

from.name: Skyhigh Insights
from.sub: Market research · Budget aviation · Feedback is a gift

title: Focus Group (whole team)
invite: Hello! We're testing a new budget airline experience and would love your whole team on board.
The experience is: you fight the cabin crew for the overhead lockers. There are feedback forms at the end.
Bring your usual squad. 💵 {cash} and a free scratch card (non-winning). One flight only.

win: Took part in an airline focus group today with my team. ✈️ Feedback given: the overhead lockers are worth fighting for. Feedback received: a trolley to the shins. #CustomerExperience #Teamwork
Our squad helped test a new budget airline. ✈️ We won the overhead lockers, the window seat and the respect of the cabin crew. Would fly again (on a different airline). #Research #Leadership
loss: Focus group report: the cabin crew are very well trained. ✈️ We were asked to remain seated. We did. On the floor. #CustomerExperience #Resilience
Some feedback for the new budget airline: the safety demonstration was performed on us. ✈️ #Research #FailForward

win: Thank you for flying with us! 💵 {cash}. Your feedback has been noted and lost.
loss: Thank you for flying with us. 💵 {cash}. Please collect your belongings and your dignity from the overhead lockers.

title: Night Guard (one night, very temporary)
invite: Good evening. Tonight's gala features a performance piece called 'Resistance'. Our night guard resigned during rehearsals.
You're the guard now. The artists will try to 'liberate' a vase. Please stop them.
They will say it's part of the piece. It isn't. It's a vase. Solo shift, 💵 {cash}. We only ask once; we're a museum, we're very busy.

win: Worked a night shift as a museum guard at a gala. 🏛️ Two performance artists tried to take a vase 'as commentary'. I responded with commentary of my own. The vase is fine. #ArtsAndCulture #Security
Proud to report I was part of a performance piece tonight without knowing it. 🏛️ Reviews call my role 'unexpectedly physical'. The vase stays. #Art #Resilience
loss: Tonight I was a museum guard for four hours and part of an art installation for six. 🏛️ The vase is gone. The critics loved it. #ArtsAndCulture #FailForward
Gala update: the performance artists won and have titled the piece after me. 🏛️ It's called 'Floor'. #Art #Vulnerability

win: The vase thanks you. So do we. 💵 {cash}.
loss: The vase is now in a private collection, apparently. 💵 {cash}. The reviews were excellent.

title: Team-building Away Day (mandatory fun)
invite: Great news! Your company has been booked onto our team-building away day. (Someone in Finance ticked a box.)
Today's exercise is Trust Fall: our facilitators fall, you catch them. Then they fall on you. Repeatedly.
Bring your usual squad. 💵 {cash} and a laminated certificate. One booking per company, per lifetime.

win: Our team just completed a team-building away day. 🪢 Key learnings: trust is earned, facilitators are heavy, and Bryony can fall from a surprising height. Certificate laminated. #Teamwork #Leadership #Synergy
Mandatory fun: completed. 🪢 We caught every facilitator, and then we caught them again, harder. Proud of this team. #TeamBuilding #Culture
loss: Today our team learned to trust each other, mostly by lying on the warehouse floor together. 🪢 #TeamBuilding #Vulnerability
Away day update: the facilitators won the trust exercise. 🪢 We have been asked to 'reflect'. We are reflecting from the floor. #Culture #FailForward

win: What a day! 💵 {cash} and your certificate is in the post. Feedback form attached (mandatory).
loss: Remember: there's no failure, only feedback. 💵 {cash}. The feedback is that you failed.

title: Contestant (cooking show pilot)
invite: Hi! We're filming the pilot of a new cooking competition and one of our contestants has dropped out (burns).
The twist: the judges fight back. Three of them. They have strong opinions and stronger forearms.
You'll cook with our celebrity chef's understudy and a sous-chef who only communicates in kitchen timers. 💵 {cash}. Pilot only, so one shot.

win: I'm a TV chef now (pilot episode, pending). 🍳 The judges said my soufflé 'lacked conviction'. They then lacked consciousness. #Cooking #Grateful #YesChef
Filmed a cooking show pilot today! 🍳 We won the judges over, one at a time, with a frying pan. Ding the sous-chef said 'ding'. High praise. #Hospitality #Teamwork
loss: Today I was eliminated from a cooking show by being physically removed from the kitchen. 🍳 The judges said I was 'raw'. Fair. #Cooking #FailForward
Cooking show update: the judges won, and then ate my entry. 🍳 Mixed reviews. #Resilience #YesChef

win: That's the pilot! 💵 {cash}. The network says it's 'too violent for daytime', which we're taking as a yes.
loss: Lovely footage. 💵 {cash}. The judges asked for your recipe and your address.
